'''Ban Landing''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the shores of [[Kato Zakar]], a continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Situated at the mouth of the [[Moon Channel]], Ban Landing served as a transit hub for [[Je'daii]] crossing the channel and visiting the the seven [[Moon Islands]] or distant [[Thyr]]. Several wooden bunkhouses were situated near the sea side for visitors to wait for their voyage to depart; the rafters of these buildings were etched with the signatures of [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s of the past on their [[Great Journey]].
